behavioral_notes.observation: Writing stage_id sets date_last_stage_update; via _track_template_for_subtype/_creation_subtype the new stage's mail_template_id is emailed, and tasks whose stage has rating_active and rating_status='stage' trigger _send_task_rating_mail(force_send=True) (line 1346). Stage transitions, not just data, drive notifications.

When a customer submits a rating on a task whose stage has auto_validation_state, rating_apply writes task state to '03_approved' if rating >= RATING_LIMIT_SATISFIED else '02_changes_requested' (lines 2125-2133). Satisfaction feedback is wired back into the workflow state - the value-shop solve/evaluate cycle.

Recurring tasks regenerate the next occurrence by copying the task and recursively re-creating its child_ids (subtasks) with date fields shifted by the recurrence delta (lines 91-116). This is the cyclical task/subtask regeneration loop, invisible to metadata.

Maps the Selection state ('1_done','1_canceled','01_in_progress','03_approved','02_changes_requested','04_waiting_normal') to distinct mail.message subtypes; stage_id changes emit mt_task_stage. The chatter audit trail is state-machine driven, not stored in metadata (lines 1613-1628).

A scheduled cron walks stages with rating_status='periodic' and calls project_ids.task_ids._send_task_rating_mail(); rating_request_deadline is computed from rating_status_period (lines 81-85, 229-236). Periodic reputation polling is automation, not a field value.

classification.rationale: project is a value-shop (intensive technology): it organizes resources around solving each engagement as a unique problem rather than a fixed throughput line. The work is cyclical - tasks move through stages, decompose into subtasks and dependencies, and loop through solve/evaluate via customer ratings that feed back into approval state (auto_validation_state). It is a primary activity delivering services (APQC 5.0 Deliver Services / service delivery and case-work), with cost anchored to account.analytic.account. The dominant value driver is reputation: rating collection (rating mixin, periodic/stage rating mails, rating_avg) signals that perceived quality of the solution, not unit cost, governs value.
